interfaces.exec: native CLI parameters, output and exit code preserved
interfaces.mcp: native stdio MCP; stdout contains protocol only
interfaces.bridge: mcp --bridge with native token and scoped filesystem roots

lifecycle.authorization: Explicit installation/update requests or the configured startup-update policy. Status, version, capabilities, doctor and help remain read-only.

updates.manager: Startup auto-update checks latest for global npm installs; npm replacement is backed up and the exact installed entry verified.
updates.runtime: update install; manifest/hash verification and immutable version directory
updates.skill: skill update; refuses unmanaged targets and local edits
updates.rollback: program state only; user images are not restored or removed

automatic.scope: global npm manager, its pinned native runtime and existing managed Skills
automatic.defer: Any active desktop/CLI/MCP/serve session; concurrent startup updates serialize
automatic.failure: Registry timeout keeps installed version; failed npm replacement restores backed-up package/entry; local Skill edits remain untouched
automatic.sourceCheckout: No self-update of development checkouts or non-global installations

limits: Native command availability depends on the installed engine version and mode
Fonts must be installed and licensed separately
Desktop GUI and Agent discovery require target-host verification
sideEffects: Skill installation writes only the selected host target
Enabled global startup updates may access npm and replace managed package/runtime/Skill files with backups; image files remain caller-owned.

sealseek.configuration: Explicit --target-root, --registry and --pool-root resolved from host configuration
